$comment: The qbittorrent-nox build rigseed ships. Changing any field here means the licence bundle and the release source archive must be regenerated. See licenses/README.md.
name: qbittorrent-nox

build.$comment: The toolchain the sidecar is compiled against. libtorrent and boost are built from source rather than taken from a package manager: qBittorrent 5.2.3 accepts libtorrent 2.0.10 - 2.0.x, and Homebrew ships 2.1.x, which does not compile. These pairings are the ones upstream's own CI tests at this tag. Editing any of these is a rebuild, and it is a change to what we redistribute.

license.note: Upstream COPYING states the source is GPLv2+ but the binary distribution is GPLv3+ because it bundles GPLv3+ assets. rigseed ships the binary, so GPLv3+ is the licence that governs redistribution.
